message: Renovate proposes updates after 1 day (minimumReleaseAge: "1 day" in renovate.json), but Poetry waits 3 days (solver.min-release-age: 3 in poetry.toml); its pull requests bring in versions younger than Poetry accepts, or fail where the lockfile is re-checked
fix: Make the Renovate delay at least 3 days, or run depcurfew apply
